blurb: Harbor Boating, Inc. operates Baltimore Water Taxi for on-demand harbor transportation, Baltimore Water Cruises for sightseeing and specialty cruises, Baltimore Water Trolley for scheduled routes connecting waterfront stops, and Baltimore Water Charters for private events and group transportation. They have been serving Baltimore since 1975 and provide commercial maritime services as well.
